scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration
scripts.test:macos: bash macos/test-capture-core.sh && pnpm run package:macos && bun scripts/test-packaged-capture-bundle.ts && pnpm run test:packaged-layout
scripts.package:macos: pnpm run build:capture && pnpm run build && bun scripts/package-macos.ts
scripts.build: bun build src/main/electron-entry.ts --outdir dist/main --target node --external electron && bun build src/auth/login-preload.ts --outdir dist/auth --target node --format cjs --external electron && bun build src/shell/main-preload.ts --outdir dist/shell --target node --format cjs --external electron && mkdir -p dist/auth dist/shell && cp src/auth/login-window.html dist/auth/login-window.html && cp src/shell/main-window.html dist/shell/main-window.html
scripts.dev: pnpm run build && pnpm run start
